summary: Full backend + frontend regression pass for the 3 map/UX fixes (bug1 minimalist tiles, bug2 walk-detail zoom, bug3 OSRM-snapped seed routes + Create snap-path). Backend: 28/28 pytest cases PASS including 3 new tests — POST /api/routing/snap returns 200 with 116-point coordinate array and distance_km>0 (OSRM public server reachable), snap requires >=2 points (400), and >=2 seeded demo walks have first-segment coordinates > 50 points (proof SEED_VERSION=2 ran and OSRM was called at seed time); enriched walk detail (pois/hazards/comments/confirmations_30d/favorited) present. Frontend WEB: Explore Leaflet map uses OSM France osmfr tiles (verified src contains 'openstreetmap.fr/osmfr'); attribution reads 'Leaflet | © OSM' — no 'CARTO' or 'API KEY REQUIRED' watermark. Walk-detail map: wheel zoom over the map did NOT scroll the parent ScrollView (delta=0 across 5 wheel events at center). All walk-detail testIDs present (share-btn, fav-detail, back-btn, post-comment, comment-input, open-confirm, add-hazard, rate-5). Create tab snap-path button present with correct 'Add at least 2 points before snapping' error at <2 points; after tapping 3 map points then snap, OSRM returned 116 waypoints and the drawn line follows real streets (verified visually). Regression flows all green: env-chip-forest/city/fields/beach/mountain, sort-recommended/distance/rating, open-digest/close-digest modal, fav-mini-*. Zero pageerrors, zero console errors across all tested screens.
action_items: None blocking. All 3 reported bugs verified fixed on WEB preview.

User should validate native (Android/iOS Expo Go) pinch zoom + drag on walk-detail WebView — automated testing cannot exercise the react-native-webview + onStartShouldSetResponder path on native (this test only proved the equivalent web behavior with touchAction:none + wheel event isolation).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:662 /api/routing/snap correctly uses OSRM public server with 15s timeout and returns HTTP 502 on upstream failure; guard for len<2 returns 400. Fine for MVP; consider caching or backing up with a second provider (Mapbox/Valhalla) for production robustness.

server.py:717 _snap_segments falls back to raw straight-line coords when OSRM fails at seed time — good graceful degradation. Currently verified 2/4 demo walks got snapped (>50 pts). If seed occasionally leaves some walks straight-line, users may still see straight lines on those walks (bug3 partial regression risk). Consider retrying failed segments on next server startup, or logging seed enrichment stats.
DoggoMap.tsx:51 & 214 use osmfr tile URL consistently across NativeMapImpl (WebView) and WebMapImpl — minimalist look confirmed on web.

DoggoMap.tsx:144/159/160/266 pinch/zoom isolation wraps map in a View with onStartShouldSetResponder + touchAction:none + WebView scrollEnabled=false + nestedScrollEnabled=true — verified on web (wheel scroll doesn't propagate to parent). Native validation deferred to user.
create.tsx:53 snapToPath uses api() helper — no direct fetch — inherits base URL from process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for web scope (Explore osmfr tiles, walk-detail zoom isolation, snap-path with real OSRM route, all regression flows)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing demo seed (user_demo0001, 4 walks, SEED_VERSION=2). TEST_ prefixed walk/comment/hazard fixtures cleaned up implicitly by fresh session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: https://barkroute.preview.emergentagent.com. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_doggo_api.py (pytest, 28 tests). OSRM public endpoint (https://router.project-osrm.org) is used both by /api/routing/snap and seed enrichment — occasional 502 possible; TestRoutingSnap.test_snap_two_points has a single retry with 2s backoff. Frontend testIDs verified: on Create — snap-path, undo-point, clear-points, create-map, publish-walk, mode-draw, mode-record, freedom-<f>, env-/diff-/dogfree-<k>, walk-title/desc/duration; on walk detail — walk-detail-map, share-btn, fav-detail, back-btn, comment-input, post-comment, open-confirm, add-hazard, rate-1..5; on Explore — env-chip-all/forest/city/fields/beach/mountain, sort-recommended/distance/rating, open-digest/close-digest, walk-mini-<id>, fav-mini-<id>, auth-submit-button. Tile source verified: 'openstreetmap.fr/osmfr' in .leaflet-tile src, attribution 'Leaflet | © OSM'.
rca_of_issue: Bug1 (map style unclear): resolved by switching Leaflet tileLayer from CartoDB Voyager (which had watermark) to https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.fr/osmfr/{z}/{x}/{y}.png (clean OSM France style, no key, no watermark). Verified src+attribution. Bug2 (walk-detail map hard to zoom): resolved by wrapping the map View with onStartShouldSetResponder=true + touchAction:'none' on the container + WebView scrollEnabled=false + nestedScrollEnabled=true so wheel/pinch events do not propagate to the parent ScrollView. Verified on web: 5 wheel-scroll events on the map yielded zero parent scroll movement. Bug3 (seeded routes cross buildings): resolved by SEED_VERSION=2 mechanism which wipes prior demo walks and re-inserts them after passing waypoints through OSRM /route foot profile; 2+ demo walks confirmed with >50 snapped coords per first segment, plus the Create-tab snap-path endpoint returns 116 real coordinates for a 3-point Paris input during live testing.
